meta.title: Intake Demand Generation: refused for a user without the Requester / End User role
gaps: Sign in as users with and without the Requester / End User role and compare their ability to use Intake Demand Generation to raise demand without an ERP feed.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as users with and without the Requester / End User role and compare their ability to use Intake Demand Generation to raise demand without an ERP feed.
